label: Speed dial input reference
info:
One inject + function node per input possibility of ui-speed-dial.

Open /dashboard/speed-dial-reference, then trigger the inject nodes.
Tip: run "Reset" (section 5) at any time to get back to the editor configuration.
Sections 1-5 cover the input protocol, section 6 client targeting, section 7 invalid messages (they must only produce a warning in the debug sidebar and never change the dial).

Client targeting needs the node to be listed under Dashboard > Client Data > Accept Client Data (already enabled in this flow) and one click on the dial first, so the flow knows your client.
